summary: The document set outlines the structure and behavior of a web page responsible for handling failed connections within an application named HSPnet. It includes both HTML and C# code aiming to provide multilingual support and proper error messaging.
purpose: To manage and display connection failure information to end users effectively while supporting both English and French languages.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Web panel for English header display.

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Web panel for French header display.

fields.name: uxErrorMessage
fields.description: Label to show error messages on connection failure.

workflows.name: Connection Failure Display Workflow
steps: Check locale setting through query string.
Display corresponding header based on locale.
Initialize culture settings based on locale.

conditions.description: HeaderEN visible when query string Locale is en-US or empty.
HeaderFR visible when query string Locale is fr-CA.

system_behavior: The page loads specified HTML content.
Culture initialization based on locale query string.
